Edit image 1. It is a photo of the client's own room, and the result must still be that same room, exactly: the same camera position, angle, lens and framing; the same walls, ceiling, floor, light fixture and outlets; the same windows, with the same frames, in the same places. Do not add, remove, move or enlarge any wall, window, door or opening, do not extend, rotate or crop the room, and do not change its light. Wherever no new furniture goes, the result is image 1 unchanged.

Images 2 to 6 are the products to add, one photo each:
image 2: wooden desk with one drawer, 118 cm wide, 45 cm deep
image 3: wood-frame swivel desk chair, 71 cm wide, 62 cm deep, 105 cm high
image 4: glass-door bookcase wall, 200 cm wide
image 5: bentwood rocking armchair, size unknown
image 6: swing-arm floor lamp with drum shade, size unknown

Add exactly these products and nothing else: no other furniture, lamps, plants, rugs or decoration than these (books on the shelves of a bookcase are fine). Each one must be the product of its photo, not a similar one: the same design, proportions, colors and materials. A product listed with "2 units" goes twice.

The client asked: "Quiero un rincón de trabajo y lectura junto al ventanal: un escritorio de madera con una silla cómoda, una biblioteca alta para mis libros contra la pared blanca de la derecha y un sillón con una lámpara de pie para leer. Estilo nórdico, maderas claras.". Arrange the products as an interior designer would for that, against the walls and on the floor that image 1 shows, each at its real size for this room, lit by this room's light. The result must look like a real photograph of image 1's room.
